units.rawText: Hurry up, Professor! We're running out of time! Hop on my bike!!!
units.displayText: Hurry up, Professor! We're running out of time! Hop on my bike!!!

spans.text: Hurry up, Professor! We're running out of time! Hop on my bike!!!

units.rawText: Before I have a chance to say no, Bonneville grabs my hand, drags me onto the backseat, and throws me a helmet.
units.displayText: Before I have a chance to say no, Bonneville grabs my hand, drags me onto the backseat, and throws me a helmet.

spans.text: Before I have a chance to say no, Bonneville grabs my hand, drags me onto the backseat, and throws me a helmet.

units.rawText: Put on your helmet, then grasp on tight! Let's goooo!!!
units.displayText: Put on your helmet, then grasp on tight! Let's goooo!!!

spans.text: Put on your helmet, then grasp on tight! Let's goooo!!!

units.rawText: With the engine roaring and Bonneville's laughter filled with excitement, we're now speeding off on a wild ride around the Oasis.
units.displayText: With the engine roaring and Bonneville's laughter filled with excitement, we're now speeding off on a wild ride around the Oasis.

spans.text: With the engine roaring and Bonneville's laughter filled with excitement, we're now speeding off on a wild ride around the Oasis.

units.rawText: Woooo! Yeah! Professor, how're you doing?
units.displayText: Woooo! Yeah! Professor, how're you doing?

spans.text: Woooo! Yeah! Professor, how're you doing?

units.rawText: ...How did it get even more intense than before... Wait a sec, why're you doing this?
units.displayText: ...How did it get even more intense than before... Wait a sec, why're you doing this?

spans.text: ...How did it get even more intense than before... Wait a sec, why're you doing this?

units.rawText: Bonneville scratches her head, looking slightly apologetic.
units.displayText: Bonneville scratches her head, looking slightly apologetic.

spans.text: Bonneville scratches her head, looking slightly apologetic.

units.rawText: I'm not like Sangoma or the other smart Dolls who can assist you with complex calculations, nor do I share the deep bonds others at the Oasis have with you. Clearly, I can't be of much help in recovering your memory.
units.displayText: I'm not like Sangoma or the other smart Dolls who can assist you with complex calculations, nor do I share the deep bonds others at the Oasis have with you. Clearly, I can't be of much help in recovering your memory.

spans.text: I'm not like Sangoma or the other smart Dolls who can assist you with complex calculations, nor do I share the deep bonds others at the Oasis have with you. Clearly, I can't be of much help in recovering your memory.

units.rawText: You shouldn't agree so readily to that!
units.displayText: You shouldn't agree so readily to that!

spans.text: You shouldn't agree so readily to that!

units.rawText: ...Anyway, I figured I could take you on a ride so we could unwind a bit together. It's the least I can do. Of course, it's mixed with me wanting to create some new memories with you.
units.displayText: ...Anyway, I figured I could take you on a ride so we could unwind a bit together. It's the least I can do. Of course, it's mixed with me wanting to create some new memories with you.

spans.text: ...Anyway, I figured I could take you on a ride so we could unwind a bit together. It's the least I can do. Of course, it's mixed with me wanting to create some new memories with you.

units.rawText: Professor, you're an invaluable biking friend to me, so please don't be so hard on yourself, okay? It pains me to see you like that.

units.rawText: No matter the obstacles ahead, I'll always rush to your aid with all the speed I have!
